usage: Eggplant is a common type of vegetable.
It is often used for cooking or steaming.
When buying eggplants, choose ones with smooth skin and no spots.
Once cooked, eggplant becomes soft and absorbs a lot of flavour.
Eggplant can be deep-fried, stir-fried, or used in stews.
